title: Defending her both ways
html_source:
The fact that the scapulars are brown suggests that they belong to the Franciscan order. The wearer of the scapulars would be protected on one side by the Virgin Mary and on the other by Saint Francis. In Bloom’s erotic imagination, it protected her from sex in the front and the rear…
(Frank Delaney’s Re:Joyce Podcast, chapter 169, Prime Meat and Policemen)
